main_text.p: in Christo, ante & post manifestationem in carne patefactæ apprehensio, Matt. 6.30. & 8.10.26. & 9.v.2.22.29. & 31. & 15.29. & 16.8. Marc. 2.5. & 4.40.40. & 5.34. & 10.52. Luc. 8.25. & 12.28. Hebr. 11. v.1.3.4. &c. ad finem capitis, & 12. Iacob. 1.6. & 5.15.
main_text.l: XIII. Declaratio omnibus facta de Christo, Act. 17.
XV. Fides miraculorum, Matth. 17.20. & 21.21. Luc. 8. Act. 14. 9.1. Cor. 12.9. & 13.2.
XVII. Sapientiæ veræ, seu doctrinæ Euangelicæ certa & exacta cognitio, Act. 6.5. & 11.24.
XIX. Fides, i. Conscientia per Euangelij doctrinam confirmata, 2. Cor. 1.24.
XX. Professio officij peculiaris circa pauperes & egenos, 1. Tim. 5.12.
main_text.p: XXI. Constantia & veritas in dictis & factis: probitas, fidelitas, vitæ integritas. Leuitic. 6.2.1. Sam. 26.23. 2. Sam. 15.20.2. Reg. 12.15. & 22.7.1. Par. 9.22. Prouer. 11.15. Ier. 7.8. & 7.28. Matt. 23.23. Gala. 5.23. 1. Tim. 4.12. & 6.11.2. Tit. 2.22. & 3.10. Tit. 2.10. Apoc. 2.19.

Fides IESV Christi, Roman. 3.22. dicitur, quæ habet in Christo, vel quæ Christo nititur: pro fide in IESVM Christum vel cuius obiectum Christus est, Gal. 2.16. bis in eodem versu, & v.20. Ex fide IESV esse, dicitur is, qui eorum numero, qui Christum fide sunt amplexi, quibus opponuntur, qui ex Circumcisione (id est, ex Lege) expectabant, Rom. 3.26. Fides Dei, 3.3. Col. 2.12. fide à Deo data, hoc est, pro constantia & veritate dictorum conuentorumque, vt supra dictum est: Passiuè, Deo habetur, Marc. 11.22. vt apparet ex v. 23. Fides nomen est, 2. Thess. 3.2. electorum est, Ioan. 8.47. & 12.v.40. Act. 13.48. Tit. 1.1.2. Pet. 1.1.

Fides non debet esse ficta, 1. Tim. 1.5. piorum fulcimentum est, 2. Corint. 1.24. fructus labiorum dicitur, Esa. 57. quia est ex auditu, Rom. 10.17. Inuocationis mater, Rom. 10.14. mortua, sine operibus, Iac. 2.v.17.26. Vide I VSI-CARE. Fides mutua appellatur à Paulo, Rom. 1.12. & ipse eos & illi vicissim ipsum iuuare possint. Fides quæ sit necessaria, Matth. 9.v.2, 22. & 21.21. Ioann. 8.24. & 18.

page.notes: Right and left margins contain faded show-through from the facing page and are not transcribed. Several words in the body are doubtful due to scan quality, notably "Pietatis", "fulcimentum", "Inuocationis" and the references in lines 14-17. The line "Fides mutua" and the final catchword area are partly illegible. The marginal word "Act" at the lower right is a faint note of uncertain reading.
